title: Tribes critical width error
statement: For each natural number $w$, let $d_w$ denote the critical dimension used in the tribes construction. Define the critical width error to be $w-\bigl(\log_2 d_w-\log_2(\log d_w)\bigr)$, where the inner logarithm is the natural logarithm.
caveat: The payload gives no definition of the critical dimension, so its meaning cannot be made self-contained beyond naming it.
